name: ADEZ XMD
description: ADEZ XMD is a WhatsApp bot with a terminal-style menu, group tools and fun commands.

SESSION_ID.description: Session ID from the pair page. Keep it private: anyone with it can control the linked WhatsApp account.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional API key for the .ai/.ask assistant commands.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Your WhatsApp number with country code, digits only, no + sign.

MODE.description: Who can use bot commands: public or private

TIMEZONE.description: Timezone for time display, e.g. Africa/Nairobi

AUTO_REACT.description: React to incoming messages (true or false)
